openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Location lead as found (unverified): Kharkiv (lead: Study in Ukraine contacts page gives "Kyrpychova str. 2", postal code 61002; medical-institute department page gives "Харків 61002, вул. Пушкінська 79, Комплекс «Гігант»"). No relocation lead found.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found; all address leads place the university in Kharkiv (Kyrpychova St 2; medical departments at Pushkinska St 79). Continued operation is indicated by: the Institute of International Education notice dated 2024-08-13 'The main recruitment of foreign students at NTU "KhPI" in the 2025/2026 academic year has begun'; a 2025 syllabus for the 226 programme; a June 2024 admissions roadmap (vstup.kpi.kharkov.ua); and the Study in Ukraine search summary saying the official site 'has a page on admission of foreign students for the 2026/2027 academic year' and pages on 'distance learning for foreign students' (pages not read). Kharkiv is a front-line city: the search surfaced general reports of war damage to Kharkiv universities (e.g., Gwara Media 2025 on Kharkiv National Medical University) but no KhPI-specific damage, suspension or relocation report. Whether teaching is in person, online or mixed is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Weak fit for a medical-admissions directory: no undergraduate medicine, dentistry or master's pharmacy degree lead; the only health-related degree lead is a BACHELOR in 226 Pharmacy, Industrial Pharmacy (industrial/technological orientation), and the medical institute appears to be postgraduate internship training only (consistent with the earlier inventory note).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead that pharmacy is open to foreign applicants or taught in English; the 2025/2026 recruitment notice points to a programme list in Ukrainian and English that the search did not expose.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Front-line city (Kharkiv); general war-damage reports for Kharkiv universities exist, no KhPI-specific report found; in-person vs distance delivery unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Two official-looking hosts in use (kpi.kharkov.ua for www/web/vstup/blogs/repository subdomains; khpi.edu.ua for e-mail and a journal host) - canonical domain unsettled.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name/domain confusion: 'KPI' in kpi.kharkov.ua and the 'Polytechnic Institute' name invite confusion with Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute (kpi.ua); 'Навчально-науковий медичний інститут' is also the name of medical units at other universities (e.g., Sumy State University).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Institution is titled 'Institute' but is a national technical UNIVERSITY (bachelor/master/doctoral per THE/uniRank leads); not a vocational 'фаховий коледж' - the title alone could mislead a reader.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO licence record, licensed volume or NAQA accreditation lead for 226 found; 222 Medicine licence lead explicitly not found.
